structured_output.what_is_happening: Around 00:20 UTC, several same-name "Cream" tokens (10+ in the packet) launched within minutes of each other. They reference a post by the X account @cremieuxrecueil (Crémieux), linked as this token's twitter. Search snippets say the post is about breastmilk ice cream. This contract (6riGra…) is one of the early deploys, created about 00:23. It has $76k market cap and $25k liquidity. Siblings are bigger: 66Rv… at $419k, Do4V… at $245k with $860k of h1 volume, and DAFB… at $207k. The token is 44% above its launch price, with 1,154 unique buyers against 137 unique sellers.

narrative.description: A meme about a viral post from Crémieux (@cremieuxrecueil), a large and polarising X account, on breastmilk ice cream. It is odd and shock-value content that can get engagement.
narrative.why_spreading: Launchpad bots and deployers copy tweet-based metas right away. There is no sign the story has spread beyond the original post and the swarm of copy tokens.

token_connection.why_this_token: Its metadata links the Crémieux status. It was one of the first deploys, but not the first: CMuvW… and Do4V… launched earlier.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 10 same-name Cream tokens. 66Rv… ($419k) and Do4V… ($245k mcap, $860k h1 volume) lead. CMuvW… was earliest, with $1.2M volume, and has already dumped to $55k.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN flags 82 bundler wallets and 9 snipers. The buyer count is high (1,154 unique) and so is the buy/sell ratio. There are no paid boosts, no smart or renowned wallets, and no DexScreener profile. In a copy-token swarm, this pattern usually means bot-driven rotation.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X posts about this contract. It is unclear whether any community has settled on one Cream.
